concerns.text: FR‑007 in the spec requires intent inference to be performed via a deterministic LLM prompt (fixed seed). The plan instead uses a rule‑based spaCy pipeline (keyword/pattern matching). This violates the functional requirement and undermines the validity of the comparison because the graph construction method differs from the mandated one.

SC‑002’s latency‑reduction claim is limited to online inference, yet the plan presents the graph‑based condition as overall more efficient without clearly quantifying the offline LLM‑free graph‑construction cost relative to the raw‑history baseline. This creates a potential accounting confound and may mislead the evaluation of the latency‑performance trade‑off.
